name: Fairchild 670
notes: Probed 2026-11-23. Two channels (L/R); the map writes the L side and relies on Ctrl Link (on by default) to move R with it.
Threshold (0-10) and Time Constant (1-6) are Fairchild controls: they carry between the 660 and 670 only. Input, balance and DC threshold come back as you left them when you return to the 670.
Output and Mix report raw knob numbers and are read through a measured table. Power stands in for the compressor's in/out.
